item.title: Whiteline KTA361 Subaru Forester SJ Front Lower Control Arm Pair
item.body_html:
Whiteline KTA361 front lower control arm pair, listed by the manufacturer for Subaru Forester SJ.

  • One kit contains two front lower control arms with bushings and ball joints.
  • Offset caster correction; the arms are not on-car adjustable.
  • Professional installation and front wheel alignment are required.

Confirm the manufacturer part number and vehicle details before ordering. A model and year label alone is not fitment confirmation.
